# Bird Palette

> Bird plumage color palettes from 10,000+ species — search by name, scientific name, or hex color.

Bird Palette (birdpalette.web.app) is a free web catalog of real bird color combinations extracted from nature photographs. Each species page shows proportional plumage colors, hex codes, and related palettes.

## Key pages

- Home: https://birdpalette.web.app/
- About: https://birdpalette.web.app/perch
- Case study: https://birdpalette.web.app/casestudy

## Example species

- Gray Heron: https://birdpalette.web.app/birds/ardea-cinerea
- Purple Heron: https://birdpalette.web.app/birds/ardea-purpurea
- Northern Cardinal: https://birdpalette.web.app/birds/cardinalis-cardinalis
